name: Klakix
description: Hosted Klakix MCP server for making videos, images, voiceovers, music and sound effects from an MCP client. 19 tools cover text-to-video and image-to-video with Seedance, Kling, Veo and Wan, image generation with Nano Banana and GPT Image, talking-photo avatars, motion transfer, 4K upscaling and explainer videos, plus 7 workflow prompts. Sign in with OAuth 2.1; generations spend Klakix credits and estimate_cost shows the price first.
author: Klakix
